recommended_geometry.board_height_formula: min(content_width * 6 / 7, play_area_height - 84), subject to explicit visual floor and vertical scrolling below the floor
recommended_geometry.board_layout: Remove the old AspectRatio; use the tight parent width and explicit height. Bind pedestal height to actual board_height.
recommended_geometry.circular_discs: The existing min(cellW,cellH) calculation preserves circles when row height differs from column width.

chosen_visual_floor.status: Root accepted design choice, not a platform requirement or measured device minimum

source_derived_cases.assumption: No system insets, default 48dp header targets plus 8dp padding, unchanged 20dp outer padding and 20dp gutter with 3:2 split

unchanged_aspect_ratio_counterexample.finding: 393.26dp total cannot fit the normal 640x360 play area.

existing_test_scope: Switches to two-player mode before size/reachability assertions.
Checks all seven render boxes for at least 48x48dp.
Uses ensureVisible for the last button, taps it and checks a real child piece in row 5/column 6.
Does not perform a finger swipe or compare exposed clipping intersections or board/button centers.
Does not cover 640x360 or enlarged text.
constraints: Retain all seven column mappings, keys and existing move assertions.
Do not scale buttons or use an input overlay to disguise the mismatch.
Each target must be fully exposable through the shared horizontal scroll.
At extreme text scale, a scroller only inside a zero-height play area is insufficient: outer portrait content must remain scrollable or reserve a nonzero play viewport.
No native 3D, rules, saves or clock changes are part of this geometry fix.
limits: Derived dimensions are explicitly source arithmetic, not new device measurements.
